evidence: Modifies argument handling and startup sequencing in src/init.cpp and subsystem argument parsing files, updating help placeholders and negation flags.
rationale: Enforcing bounds on numeric startup arguments prevents silent integer wrap-arounds and unexpected logic inversions across node configuration options. Providing fatal startup errors instead of silent misconfigurations improves user-facing argument handling, though doing so via piecemeal checks rather than centralized parsing limits its leverage.
